_meta.note: The DDO wiki's enumeration of RANGED weapons, harvested to source the Melee/Ranged split that `Essence Crafting/table 1b` names but never defines. Verbatim names from `Table: Basic Ranged Weapons`.
_meta.melee_is_not_enumerated: There is NO `Melee weapons` article - the page returns 'We don't currently have an article called "Melee weapons"' - and no category for it either. Melee therefore remains a COMPLEMENT and is labelled an inference wherever it is used. This shard deliberately does not list melee types: writing them out would dress a complement up as a harvest.
_meta.why_thrown_is_absent: All five thrown types are absent from the ranged enumeration, and `Thrown weapons` lists `Ranged weapons` under See also - a sibling, never a parent. It defines them only as 'any weapon that may be physically thrown at a target over a distance'. So the wiki does not place them in either of table 1b's two groups, and they stay refused.
_meta.why_handwraps_is_absent: `Handwrap` never calls them melee or ranged, and states 'handwraps are not programmed as weapons by design'.
